title: Proper pro-etale direct image preserves extension-by-zero support
statement:
Let $u:T_1\to T_2$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism], and let $j_1:X\hookrightarrow T_1$ and $j_2:X\hookrightarrow T_2$ be quasi-compact open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] satisfying $u\circ j_1=j_2$. Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Use the constant-ring module sheaves and ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $Ru_*$ and $j_2^*$ be the uncompleted derived direct image and exact inverse image [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], and let $j_{i!}$ be extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero], applied termwise using its exactness [lem-weil-extension-by-zero-exact]. For every $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ put $M=Ru_*j_{1!}K$. The canonical counit of the derived open adjunction [prop-exc-open-adjoint] is an isomorphism:
$$j_{2!}j_2^*M\longrightarrow M.$$
This is a statement of support on the whole pro-etale derived category; it imposes no etale-origin or boundedness condition on $K$.

source.place: Clause (b), compactification independence: agent-extracted proper/open support obligation. Related source: Stacks proetale.tex Tag 09AG, lemma-jshriek-zero (degree-zero specialization vanishing only); this tag does not itself state the derived proper-support assertion.

proof.text: Form V = T₁ ×_{T₂} X, with open projection b:V→T₁ and proper projection r:V→X. The map s=(j₁,id):X→V is open, since b∘s=j₁. Extension-by-zero composition identifies j₁!M with b!s!M. The proper/open sheaf comparison gives f_*b!s!M ≅ j₂!r_*s!M. Thus f_*j₁!M belongs to the essential image of the fully faithful j₂!, and the actual counit is invertible. The comparison itself supplies all boundary specialization arguments.

For K bounded below, choose a bounded-below injective complex J representing K. Exactness of j₁! represents j₁!K termwise. Apply the open-injective proper-acyclic theorem with r=id_X: every j₁!J^q is f_*-acyclic. The right-derived-functor plus compatibility and its acyclic-complex computation identify Rf_*j₁!K with Q(f_*j₁!J). Step 1 makes its terms supported. The termwise sheaf counit is an isomorphism of complexes, so Q(f_*j₁!J) lies in the essential image of derived j₂!. Fully faithful left adjunction then makes the specified derived counit invertible.

For fixed scalar modules, immersion inverse image preserves countable products: commute its left-Kan-extension/sheafification construction with the forgetful functor to abelian sheaves, use abelian immersion limit preservation, and reflect limits through the faithful limit-preserving forgetful functor. For a quasi-compact open j choose the reduced closed complement i. The open-closed sequence identifies j!j* as the kernel of id→i_*i*. Both other functors preserve products, so the kernel functor does too. Since j* is essentially surjective and preserves products, j! preserves them. Transport through the canonical coefficient equivalences gives this for the intrinsic functors.

Products of pro-etale module sheaves are exact. Consequently Q sends termwise products of complexes to derived products, as in the existing TowerLimit API (isLimitFanQ and its preservation instance), by products of K-injective replacements and exactness. Using the factorization Q⋙D(F) ≅ F_complex⋙Q and essential surjectivity of Q, every exact sheaf functor preserving products induces a product-preserving derived functor. Apply this to j₁!, j₂!, j₂*. Rf_* preserves products by the derived inverse-image/direct-image adjunction. All these functors are triangulated.

Represent arbitrary K by a complex L and use its strict lower-truncation tower. The canonical Postnikov comparison L→Cone(1−T)[−1] is a quasi-isomorphism. Applying Q to the mapping-cocone distinguished triangle and using Q-preservation of products constructs a homotopy-limit cone whose vertex is Q(L). The cone equations follow from (1−T) followed by each product projection. Transport the cone along the comparison isomorphism.

The essential image of fully faithful derived j₂! is closed under these homotopy limits: for a termwise supported tower T the counit identifies j₂!j₂*T with T; applying both product-preserving triangulated functors to a homotopy-limit cone gives another cone for T. Uniqueness of the homotopy-limit vertex up to isomorphism puts its vertex in the essential image of j₂!, so the actual counit is invertible by the adjunction. Apply this to the image of the Postnikov cone under Rf_*j₁!. Step 2 supplies support on each bounded-below truncation, and transporting along Q(L)≅K finishes.

proof_origin.place: Clause (b), compactification independence. Lean proof: proper/open sheaf comparison; bounded-below injective acyclic computation; exact products and explicit Postnikov homotopy-limit cones. The support class is closed under these cones by full faithfulness of the actual open adjunction.
